response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine geospatial background (GISCollective founder, Green Map GIS work, FOSS4G speaker) and proven low-latency systems experience at Sociomantic handling millions of requests per second. However, his systems work was primarily in DLang rather than the required modern C++ or Rust, his C++ exposure is limited and dated (2014-2015), and his recent roles have been TypeScript/Node.js full-stack rather than navigation or routing pipeline engineering. He could likely ramp up given his adaptability, but he lacks direct experience with routing/navigation guidance systems.
strengths: Founded and maintains an open-source geospatial data platform (GISCollective) used in production
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic)
Demonstrated adaptability across the full stack, strong testing culture, and Linux/DevOps competence
concerns: Minimal and outdated modern C++ experience; no Rust; core systems work was in DLang
No direct experience building navigation guidance or routing tile pipelines
Recent years focused on TypeScript/web product work, away from performance-critical systems engineering
